entry.text: Joint19 confirmed, sharpening joint15/16: for the same auxiliary noisy contacts and fixed SPD additive full-space spring quartet, the omitted-block determinant cycle is negative conditional Gaussian information, and the retained Schur cycle is conditional minus unconditional information. Precisely, \(\Delta F_D/\theta=-I(x;y\mid z)\) and \(\Delta F_S/\theta=I(x;y\mid z)-I(x;y)\), with \(\theta=k_BT\). Derivation: ada/conditional-information.md:9-56. The joint16 witness has unconditional information0.02041099726 and conditional information0.05889151783 nats, explaining its positive retained cycle. ada/check_conditional_information.py:17-52 compares conditional covariance from omitted-block solves with conditioning the full joint covariance, then checks separate full/omitted/retained determinants. A one-retained-only-bundle control and120 seeded synthetic SPD rank-two/rank-three cases pass; maximum identity residual3.9968e-15 (conditional-information-results.json). This is new algebraic interpretation of inherited constructions, not new molecular evidence or novelty.
